extraction_scope.worker_6_note: Worker-6 replaced framework placeholder mechanism notes with source-reviewed direct/context mechanism claims from XML/PDF figure captions and results sections.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: SpHyastatin compromises microbial membrane integrity as supported by propidium iodide uptake after peptide treatment.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: recombinant SpHyastatin tested against microbial cells

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=21:The Uptake of PI into Microbes Induced by SpHyastatin;xml:fig=4:FIGURE 4

mechanism_claims.limitations: Figure-level fluorescence images support membrane permeabilization qualitatively; no exact numeric permeability value is extracted from local material.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: SEM images support peptide-induced surface/membrane morphology disruption in tested bacteria and yeast.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: S. aureus, P. fluorescens, and P. pastoris after SpHyastatin exposure

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=22:SpHyastatin Induces Morphological Changes in Microbes;xml:fig=5:FIGURE 5

mechanism_claims.limitations: Morphology evidence is qualitative image evidence and should not be converted into exact lysis percentages.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Localization differs by microbe: source reports surface localization in some tested cells and broader intracellular localization in P. fluorescens.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: S. aureus, P. fluorescens, and P. pastoris localization assay

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=23:Different Localization Sites of SpHyastatin on Different Microbes;xml:fig=6:FIGURE 6

mechanism_claims.limitations: The source supports species-specific localization patterns, not a universal cytoplasmic target claim for every organism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Binding assays support interaction with microbial surface molecules and chitin as a plausible upstream contributor to antimicrobial activity.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: SpHyastatin, PRD, and CRD binding assays
mechanism_claims.limitations: Binding evidence is mechanistic context and is not promoted alone to a killing mechanism without the PI/SEM/localization evidence.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: In vivo challenge and qPCR figures support host protection and immune-gene modulation after SpHyastatin treatment in the crab infection model.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: S. paramamosain challenged with V. parahaemolyticus

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=24:SpHyastatin Increases S. paramamosain Survival;xml:sec=25:SpHyastatin Modulating the V. parahaemolyticus Infection-Mediated Immune Gene Expression Profiles;xml:fig=7:FIGURE 7;xml:fig=8:FIGURE 8

mechanism_claims.limitations: Host-response evidence is retained as in vivo context, not direct antimicrobial target evidence.
